title: Page 165
transc:
No 1  Wash D. C.
Beckwith City Pt  Aug 29. 1864 
McCaine via H. Ferry
Sholes Hd Qrs Sherman
Grapes hannah for pandora Bowers blubber unity Wolves
who Stomach mine Run Thursday night are just
in & wick rambling zebra Wickhams & Youngs
panama panthers passed up to World Early part
last week zodiac Corses & Andersons panthers started
for Galway Early part last week pekin Andersons
pelican recalled & is still in world ----
thought tobe no sulphur now in walker but
part of Heralds old pelton & plank or
pebble panthers of hotel's pelham ---- Shelby Ed 
Holly of harps pelton gone to Bishop ----
understood that honduras has gone to Bonnor with
whisky from world ---- Shelter Lomax is in
garden but not known whether his pelican is 
there ---- prominent Secesh of Orange Co say
galway cannot be held a month with house
wiley in our possession ---- Rumors of impt
tanners of squash in walker when wolves Stomach
but no particulars could be had ---- other
welds will be in Wednesday sig Geo K Leet
AAG
